subject: Vendor onboarding & purchase-ref alignment (Convergent Labs)
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora@convergent.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@convergent.io
Date: 2026-05-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Vendor onboarding & PO reference alignment

Hi Markus,

Thanks for onboarding Convergent Labs — excited to get started. Attached is our completed vendor onboarding form (v2). Two items we want to confirm up front so we can hit our launch timeline:

• PO number issuance: our SRE team needs a provisional purchase reference to attach to the first invoice. Can you confirm the earliest you can issue this?
• Spend cap & line items: we requested a $120,000 launch cap in the form but we see your public onboarding notes default to $50k provisional. We also flagged two line items that map to our internal SKU A1/ B3 which we’d like consolidated.

We’ve attached the onboarding form and a spreadsheet with our proposed initial order (initial_po_request.csv). Happy to hop on a 20m call if helpful.

Attachments: convergent_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 270KB); initial_po_request.csv (text/csv, 18KB)

Best,
Nora Patel
Vendor Operations
Convergent Labs
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@convergent.io>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vendor onboarding & PO reference alignment

Nora — thanks for the form and the deck. We can move quickly here. A couple quick clarifying notes before we provision anything:

1) Line-item consolidation: can you confirm whether A1 (runtime credits) and B3 (support add-on) should be billed as a single product code for Redwood invoicing, or if Convergent prefers separate invoice lines? If consolidated we’ll map both to our internal SKU RL-TR-01 and that will simplify the PO line mapping.
2) Spend cap: our standard provisional allocation for new vendors starts at $50,000 but we do have a one-time launch exception process. To speed this up please share the signed SOW or a purchase order that indicates the $120k ask (even as a proc-side note) and we’ll start a spend-cap escalation.
3) Tax / billing info: we need your W-9 or equivalent (tax ID) to finalize the purchase-ref.

I’ve looped in Priyom (procurement) and Monica (vendor ops) to coordinate the provisional PO and line remap. Priyom — can you run the provisional purchase-ref and advise on timeline for the spend-cap escalation? Monica — can you take the line-item mapping once Nora confirms?

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Nora Patel <nora@convergent.io>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Vendor onboarding & PO reference alignment

Hi all —

Thanks Nora — quick checklist from procurement so we can issue a provisional purchase-ref: 

• Completed onboarding form (received)
• Tax ID / W-9 (please attach)
• Cost center mapping (how should we map invoices to your cost centers?)
• Initial PO or SOW indicating requested cap (any PDF/email is fine)

We can issue a provisional purchase reference once we have tax info and a sign that the customer expects a $120k allocation. Typical timeline: 1–2 business days to issue a provisional P-REF internally; spend-cap escalations to increase beyond $50k require Finance approval (Grace) and a short justification.

I’m attaching a procurement-side template we use for initial PO intake (procurement intake template). If Convergent can populate the tax ID and a billing contact, we’ll start the P-REF.

Attachment: procurement_template.csv (text/csv, 6KB)

–Priyom
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-05-25T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Purchase-ref issued and line item correction required

Team — quick update for the thread and next steps: 

• We issued a provisional purchase reference: P-2026-8472 (status: provisional).
• Spend cap: I initiated the escalation for a one-time launch increase to $120,000. Finance approval required — tagging Grace.
• Line-item correction: while mapping Convergent’s initial_po_request.csv into our ledger we discovered duplicate semantics across SKU columns A1 and B3. Per Convergent’s note we consolidated both into internal SKU RL-TR-01 and added a corrected line-item file (convergent_lineitem_fix.csv). This will change the billing lines on any generated invoices.

Next actions: 
1) Grace — please approve the $120k temporary increase so we can remove the provisional cap hold. If you need any additional justification, I’ve attached the SOW and a short launch risk note.
2) Markus / Priyom — once Grace signs off I’ll mark P-2026-8472 as active and notify Convergent with the purchase-ref and confirmed invoice routing.

Attachments: convergent_lineitem_fix.csv (text/csv, 9KB); launch_risk_note.pdf (application/pdf, 28KB)

Thanks,
Monica
Vendor Enablement Lead
Redwood Inference
